   **Баги и стабильность.**
      22 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 8 июн. 2026 г. - 18 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _BGS Jason_, 18 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "This app used to be functional. Whenever the major UI update rolled out, it’s been riddled with bugs. Whatever you guys did made this app borderline unusable. I assume the technology was offshored and that’s why it turned into what it is now"
            2. _Notcool49_, 17 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "Used to be great until they updated the app. Now it’s horrible and just freezes everything and won’t unblock anything. I guess it’s good cause now I can’t look at anything. Never make the mistake of updating!"
            3. _AverageMean_, 13 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "used to love the app but its filled with bugs (apps not blocking or blocking in loops when unblocked, spamming notifications…) since the 4.x update :( is there any way to get the old app back?"
